name: Givers World Mission Student Management System
description: A professional and comprehensive administrative web platform for Givers World Mission (Kambia 2, Northern Province, Kambia) supporting Nursery 1-3, Primary 1-6, JSS 1-3, SSS 1-3, and University Year 1-4 with Certificate and Diploma programs, continuous assessments, grades, national exams, attendance, and fee management.
